note: Fayette County IL (17051): no queryable zoning district service found in county or city sources. County GIS is a Sidwell portal (portico.sidwellco.com) that exposes parcels, not a zoning layer found. Vandalia, the largest city, publishes its zoning only as a PDF map (April 2017). Other municipalities (Ramsey, St. Elmo, Brownstown) publish no zoning service found. A generic 'Zoning_Districts' FeatureServer on ArcGIS Online (owner f4rR7WnIfGBdVYFd) has no features in Fayette County and is not theirs.
